title: QMatBridge: A bridge from classical materials databases to first-quantized Hamiltonians for quantum simulation
description: QMatBridge is a Python library that turns classical materials-database records into a neutral, provenance-rich description of the Hamiltonian (QMatEntry) for fault-tolerant quantum simulation. Entries carry provenance and a deterministic canonical hash so benchmark results can be compared and reproduced. Developed by q-matsuite.
